sn47.9:1.2: ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā vesāliyaṃ viharati veluvagāmake.
sn47.9:1.4: etha tumhe bhikkhave samantā vesāliyā yathāmittaṃ yathāsandiṭṭhaṃ yathāsambhattaṃ vassaṃ upetha
sn47.9:1.6: evambhanteti kho te bhikkhū bhagavato paṭissutvā samantā vesāliyā yathāmittaṃ yathāsandiṭṭhaṃ yathāsambhattaṃ vassaṃ upagacchuṃ.
sn47.9:1.7: bhagavā pana tattheva veluvagāmake vassaṃ upagacchi.
sn47.9:2.1: atha kho bhagavato vassūpagatassa kharo ābādho uppajjati bāḷhā vedanā vattanti maraṇantikā.
sn47.9:2.2: tatra sudaṃ bhagavā sato sampajāno adhivāseti avihaññamāno.
sn47.9:2.4: na kho pana metampaṭirūpaṃ yohamanāmantetvā upaṭṭhāke anapaloketvā bhikkhusaṅghaṃ parinibbāyeyyaṃ
sn47.9:2.5: yannūnāhaṃ imaṃ ābādhaṃ viriyena paṭippaṇāmetvā jīvitasaṅkhāraṃ adhiṭṭhāya vihareyyanti.
sn47.9:2.6: atha kho bhagavā taṃ ābādhaṃ viriyena paṭippaṇāmetvā jīvitasaṅkhāraṃ adhiṭṭhāya vihāsi.
sn47.9:3.1: atha kho bhagavā gilānā vuṭṭhito aciravuṭṭhito gelaññā vihārapacchāyāyaṃ paññatte āsane nisīdi.
sn47.9:3.2: atha kho āyasmā ānando yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkami upasaṅkamitvā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi. ekamantaṃ nisinno kho āyasmā ānando bhagavantaṃ etadavoca
sn47.9:3.6: api me bhante madhurakajāto viya kāyo disāpi me na pakkhāyanti dhammāpi maṃ nappaṭibhanti bhagavato gelaññena
sn47.9:3.7: apica me bhante ahosi kācideva assāsamattā
sn47.9:3.8: na tāva bhagavā paribbāyissati na tāva bhagavā bhikkhusaṅghaṃ ārabbha kiñcideva udāharatīti.
sn47.9:4.1: kiṃ panadāni ānanda bhikkhusaṅgho mayi paccāsiṃsati.
sn47.9:4.2: desito ānanda mayā dhammo anantaraṃ abāhiraṃ karitvā.
sn47.9:4.5: ahaṃ bhikkhusaṅghaṃ pariharissāmīti vā mamuddesiko bhikkhusaṅghoti vā. so nūnānanda bhikkhusaṅghaṃ ārabbha kiñcideva udāhareyya.
sn47.9:4.6: tathāgatassa kho ānanda na evaṃ hoti
sn47.9:4.7: ahaṃ bhikkhusaṅghaṃ pariharissāmīti vā mamuddesiko bhikkhusaṅghoti vā.
sn47.9:4.8: sa kiṃ ānanda tathāgato bhikkhusaṅghaṃ ārabbha kiñcideva udāharissati.
sn47.9:4.9: etarahi kho panāhaṃ ānanda jiṇṇo vuḍḍho mahallako addhagato vayo anuppatto
sn47.9:4.12: evameva kho ānanda veḷumissako maññe tathāgatassa kāyo yāpeti.
sn47.9:5.1: yasmiṃ ānanda samaye tathāgato sabbanimittānaṃ amanasikārā ekaccānaṃ vedanānaṃ nirodhā animittaṃ cetosamādhiṃ upasampajja viharati phāsutaraṃ ānanda tasmiṃ samaye tathāgatassa hoti.
sn47.9:5.2: tasmā tihānanda attadīpā viharatha attasaraṇā anaññasaraṇā dhammadīpā dhammasaraṇā anaññasaraṇā.
sn47.9:6.1: kathañca ānanda bhikkhu attadīpo viharati attasaraṇo anaññasaraṇo dhammadīpo dhammasaraṇo anaññasaraṇo.
sn47.9:6.2: idhānanda bhikkhu kāye kāyānupassī viharati ātāpī sampajāno satimā vineyya loke abhijjhādomanassaṃ.
sn47.9:6.5: dhammesu dhammānupassī viharati ātāpī sampajāno satimā vineyya loke abhijjhādomanassaṃ.
sn47.9:6.6: evaṃ kho ānanda bhikkhu attadīpo viharati attasaraṇo anaññasaraṇo dhammadīpo dhammasaraṇo anaññasaraṇo.
sn47.9:6.7: ye hi keci ānanda etarahi vā mamaccaye vā attadīpā viharissanti attasaraṇā anaññasaraṇā dhammadīpā dhammarasaṇā anaññasaraṇā. tamataggeme te ānanda bhikkhū bhavissanti ye keci sikkhākāmāti.
